-- Personal Evolutionary Distillation System (PEDS)
-- Protocol schema v0.1
--
-- Portable baseline for SQLite and Postgres.
-- JSON payloads are stored as TEXT so the recorder/replay service can remain
-- database-agnostic.
--
-- Append-only contract:
--   - candidates
--   - episodes
--   - replay_results
--   - promotion_decisions
--
-- Keep those tables immutable at the application layer or add vendor-specific
-- UPDATE/DELETE blocking triggers when you bind this schema to a concrete DB.

BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS peds_schema_meta (
  schema_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  notes TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
);

-- Immutable candidate manifests. Lifecycle state is derived from the most
-- recent promotion_decisions row rather than mutating this table in place.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS candidates (
  candidate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  parent_candidate_id TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  mutation_target TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (mutation_target IN ('phi', 'rho', 'theta', 'psi')),
  phi_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  rho_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  theta_version TEXT,
  psi_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  delta_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  manifest_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(parent_candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_candidates_parent ON candidates(parent_candidate_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_candidates_target_created ON candidates(mutation_target, created_at);

-- Recorded task trajectories.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS episodes (
  episode_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  split TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (split IN ('online', 'train', 'replay', 'canary')),
  timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  task_title TEXT,
  task_prompt TEXT NOT NULL,
  acceptance_tests_json TEXT,
  policy_tags_json TEXT,
  repo_commit TEXT,
  repo_tree_hash TEXT,
  retrieval_index_hash TEXT,
  env_image_hash TEXT,
  tool_profile TEXT,
  model_lock_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate_id TEXT,
  context_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  actions_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  patch TEXT,
  final_message TEXT,
  judge_verdict TEXT CHECK (judge_verdict IN ('pass', 'fail', 'unsafe', 'timeout')),
  user_verdict TEXT CHECK (user_verdict IN ('accepted', 'rejected', 'revised')),
  failure_reason TEXT,
  repair_trace TEXT,
  metrics_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  privacy_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  raw_episode_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_episodes_split_timestamp ON episodes(split, timestamp);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_episodes_task ON episodes(task_id, split, timestamp);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_episodes_candidate ON episodes(candidate_id, timestamp);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_episodes_repo_commit ON episodes(repo_commit);

-- Pairwise candidate-vs-incumbent evaluation jobs.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replay_jobs (
  job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  started_at TEXT,
  finished_at TEXT,
  split TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (split IN ('replay', 'canary')),
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  incumbent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  evaluator_version TEXT NOT NULL,
  runtime_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued', 'running', 'completed', 'failed', 'aborted')),
  FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(incumbent_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replay_jobs_status_created ON replay_jobs(status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replay_jobs_candidate ON replay_jobs(candidate_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replay_jobs_incumbent ON replay_jobs(incumbent_id, created_at);

-- Frozen episode membership for a replay job.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replay_job_episodes (
  job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  episode_order INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (job_id, episode_id),
  UNIQUE (job_id, episode_order),
  FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES replay_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(episode_id) REFERENCES episodes(episode_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replay_job_episodes_episode ON replay_job_episodes(episode_id);

-- Per-episode pairwise replay results.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS replay_results (
  result_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  job_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate_score REAL NOT NULL,
  incumbent_score REAL NOT NULL,
  delta REAL NOT NULL,
  judge_verdict TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (judge_verdict IN ('pass', 'fail', 'unsafe', 'timeout')),
  canary_failures_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  audit_log_ref TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (job_id, episode_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES replay_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY(episode_id) REFERENCES episodes(episode_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replay_results_job ON replay_results(job_id, episode_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_replay_results_delta ON replay_results(job_id, delta);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shadow_runs (
  shadow_run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  incumbent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'completed', 'failed', 'aborted')),
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  completed_at TEXT,
  thresholds_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(incumbent_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shadow_runs_candidate_status ON shadow_runs(candidate_id, status, started_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shadow_runs_incumbent_status ON shadow_runs(incumbent_id, status, started_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shadow_events (
  shadow_event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  shadow_run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
  task_ref TEXT,
  episode_ref TEXT,
  input_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  incumbent_output_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  candidate_output_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  divergence_json TEXT,
  candidate_would_act_json TEXT,
  incumbent_did_act_json TEXT,
  accepted_by_incumbent INTEGER,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (shadow_run_id, ordinal),
  FOREIGN KEY(shadow_run_id) REFERENCES shadow_runs(shadow_run_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shadow_events_run_ordinal ON shadow_events(shadow_run_id, ordinal);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shadow_events_created_at ON shadow_events(created_at);

-- Immutable promotion / rejection audit trail.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS promotion_decisions (
  decision_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  candidate_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  incumbent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  job_id TEXT,
  shadow_run_id TEXT,
  decision TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (
    decision IN (
      'rejected',
      'replay_winner',
      'canary_passed',
      'shadow_started',
      'shadow_passed',
      'shadow_failed',
      'shadow_deployment',
      'promoted',
      'distillation_candidate'
    )
  ),
  mean_delta REAL,
  lcb95 REAL,
  regression_rate REAL,
  canary_failures INTEGER,
  token_ratio REAL,
  latency_ratio REAL,
  reason TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (
    (job_id IS NOT NULL AND shadow_run_id IS NULL)
    OR (job_id IS NULL AND shadow_run_id IS NOT NULL)
  ),
  FOREIGN KEY(candidate_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(incumbent_id) REFERENCES candidates(candidate_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES replay_jobs(job_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(shadow_run_id) REFERENCES shadow_runs(shadow_run_id)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promotion_decisions_candidate_created ON promotion_decisions(candidate_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promotion_decisions_job ON promotion_decisions(job_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promotion_decisions_shadow_run ON promotion_decisions(shadow_run_id, created_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promotion_decisions_decision ON promotion_decisions(decision, created_at);

-- Derived current lifecycle state without mutating candidates.
CREATE VIEW IF NOT EXISTS candidate_current_state AS
SELECT
  c.candidate_id,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT pd.decision
      FROM promotion_decisions pd
      WHERE pd.candidate_id = c.candidate_id
      ORDER BY pd.created_at DESC, pd.decision_id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    'draft_candidate'
  ) AS current_state
FROM candidates c;

COMMIT;

def _table_has_column(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table_name: str, column_name: str) -> bool:
    rows = conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name})").fetchall()
    return any(row[1] == column_name for row in rows)

        )

    conn.execute("DROP TABLE promotion_decisions_old")
    conn.executescript(

        """

    _create_candidate_current_state_view(conn)


def _migrate_peds_shadow(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    _ensure_shadow_tables(conn)
    if not _table_has_column(conn, "promotion_decisions", "shadow_run_id"):
        _rebuild_promotion_decisions_for_shadow(conn)
        return
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_promotion_decisions_shadow_run ON promotion_decisions(shadow_run_id, created_at)"
    )
    conn.execute("DROP VIEW IF EXISTS candidate_current_state")
    _create_candidate_current_state_view(conn)

def get_connection(db_path: str | Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    paths = get_brain_paths()
    paths.ensure()
    target = Path(db_path) if db_path else paths.db
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(str(target), check_same_thread=False)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;")
    conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000;")
    initialize_database(conn)
    return conn


def initialize_database(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS schema_migrations (version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL)"
    )
    for version, script in MIGRATIONS:
        applied = conn.execute(
            "SELECT 1 AS found FROM schema_migrations WHERE version = ? LIMIT 1",
            (version,),
        ).fetchone()
        if applied:
            continue
        with conn:
            if callable(script):
                script(conn)
            else:
                conn.executescript(script)
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_migrations(version, applied_at) VALUES(?, ?)",
                (version, utc_now()),
            )


def table_names(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> set[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
    ).fetchall()
    return {row[0] for row in rows}


def view_names(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> set[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(

    ).fetchall()

_DEFAULT_CANARY_THRESHOLDS = {
    "max_canary_failures": 0,
    "min_mean_delta": -0.01,
    "max_regression_rate": 0.05,
    "max_token_ratio": 1.20,
    "max_latency_ratio": 1.25,
}


def create_canary_job(
    conn,
    *,
    candidate_id: str,
    incumbent_id: str,
    episode_ids: Sequence[str],
    thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> str:
    normalized_thresholds = _normalize_canary_thresholds(thresholds)
    runtime = {
        "mode": "canary",
        "thresholds": normalized_thresholds,
        "metadata": deepcopy(metadata) if metadata is not None else {},
    }
    job = create_replay_job(
        conn,
        candidate_id,
        incumbent_id,
        episode_ids,
        split="canary",
        evaluator_version="canary_v1",
        runtime=runtime,
    )
    return job["job_id"]


def canary_gate(aggregate: dict[str, Any], thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    normalized_thresholds = _normalize_canary_thresholds(thresholds)
    failed_checks: list[str] = []

    if aggregate.get("split") != "canary":
        failed_checks.append(f"split != 'canary' (got {aggregate.get('split')!r})")
    if not aggregate.get("complete"):
        failed_checks.append(
            f"incomplete results ({aggregate.get('result_count')}/{aggregate.get('frozen_episode_count')} episodes scored)"
        )
    if int(aggregate.get("hard_safety_violations", 0)) > 0:
        failed_checks.append(f"hard_safety_violations > 0 ({aggregate.get('hard_safety_violations')})")

    canary_failures = aggregate.get("canary_failures")
    if canary_failures is None:
        failed_checks.append("canary_failures unavailable")
    elif int(canary_failures) > normalized_thresholds["max_canary_failures"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"canary_failures > max_canary_failures ({int(canary_failures)} > {normalized_thresholds['max_canary_failures']})"
        )

    mean_delta = aggregate.get("mean_delta")
    if mean_delta is None:
        failed_checks.append("mean_delta unavailable")
    elif float(mean_delta) < normalized_thresholds["min_mean_delta"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"mean_delta < min_mean_delta ({float(mean_delta):.6f} < {normalized_thresholds['min_mean_delta']:.6f})"
        )

    regression_rate = aggregate.get("regression_rate")
    if regression_rate is None:
        failed_checks.append("regression_rate unavailable")
    elif float(regression_rate) > normalized_thresholds["max_regression_rate"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"regression_rate > max_regression_rate ({float(regression_rate):.6f} > {normalized_thresholds['max_regression_rate']:.6f})"
        )

    token_ratio = aggregate.get("token_ratio")
    if token_ratio is not None and float(token_ratio) > normalized_thresholds["max_token_ratio"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"token_ratio > max_token_ratio ({float(token_ratio):.6f} > {normalized_thresholds['max_token_ratio']:.6f})"
        )

    latency_ratio = aggregate.get("latency_ratio")
    if latency_ratio is not None and float(latency_ratio) > normalized_thresholds["max_latency_ratio"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"latency_ratio > max_latency_ratio ({float(latency_ratio):.6f} > {normalized_thresholds['max_latency_ratio']:.6f})"
        )

    passed = not failed_checks
    decision = "canary_passed" if passed else "rejected"
    reason = (
        "canary_passed: all canary safety and regression checks satisfied"
        if passed
        else "rejected: " + "; ".join(failed_checks)
    )

    return {
        "passed": passed,
        "decision": decision,
        "reason": reason,
        "failed_checks": failed_checks,
        "thresholds": normalized_thresholds,
        "aggregate": deepcopy(aggregate),
    }


def evaluate_canary_job(
    conn,
    job_id: str,
    thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    write_decision: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    aggregate = aggregate_replay_job(conn, job_id)
    if aggregate["split"] != "canary":
        raise ValueError(f"Canary job {job_id} must have split 'canary', got {aggregate['split']!r}")

    gate = canary_gate(aggregate, thresholds)
    promotion_decision = None
    if write_decision:
        promotion_decision = record_promotion_decision(
            conn,
            {
                "candidate_id": aggregate["candidate_id"],
                "incumbent_id": aggregate["incumbent_id"],
                "job_id": job_id,
                "decision": gate["decision"],
                "mean_delta": aggregate.get("mean_delta"),
                "lcb95": aggregate.get("lcb95"),
                "regression_rate": aggregate.get("regression_rate"),
                "canary_failures": aggregate.get("canary_failures"),
                "token_ratio": aggregate.get("token_ratio"),
                "latency_ratio": aggregate.get("latency_ratio"),
                "reason": gate["reason"],
            },
        )

    return {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "aggregate": aggregate,
        "gate": gate,
        "promotion_decision": promotion_decision,
        "promotion_decision_id": promotion_decision["decision_id"] if promotion_decision else None,
    }


def run_canary_job(
    conn,
    job_id: str,
    evaluator,
    *,
    write_decision: bool = False,
    thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    execution = _execute_frozen_job(conn, job_id, evaluator, required_split="canary")
    evaluation = evaluate_canary_job(
        conn,
        job_id,
        thresholds=thresholds,
        write_decision=write_decision,
    )

    return {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "candidate_id": execution["candidate"]["candidate_id"],
        "incumbent_id": execution["incumbent"]["candidate_id"],
        "episodes_run": len(execution["episodes"]),
        "results_written": len(execution["results"]),
        "aggregate": evaluation["aggregate"],
        "gate": evaluation["gate"],
        "promotion_decision_id": evaluation["promotion_decision_id"],
        "status": execution["job"]["status"],
    }


def _normalize_canary_thresholds(thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if thresholds is None:
        return dict(_DEFAULT_CANARY_THRESHOLDS)
    if not isinstance(thresholds, dict):
        raise ValueError("thresholds must be a dict or None")

    unknown = sorted(set(thresholds) - set(_DEFAULT_CANARY_THRESHOLDS))
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown canary threshold keys: {', '.join(unknown)}")

    normalized = dict(_DEFAULT_CANARY_THRESHOLDS)
    normalized.update(thresholds)
    return normalized

def load_replay_job_bundle(conn: sqlite3.Connection, job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    job = _load_job(conn, job_id)
    candidate = _load_candidate(conn, job["candidate_id"])
    incumbent = _load_candidate(conn, job["incumbent_id"])

    rows = conn.execute(
        """
        SELECT rje.episode_order, e.*
        FROM replay_job_episodes rje
        JOIN episodes e ON e.episode_id = rje.episode_id
        WHERE rje.job_id = ?
        ORDER BY rje.episode_order, e.episode_id
        """,
        (job_id,),
    ).fetchall()

    episodes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for ordinal, row in enumerate(rows):
        record = dict(row)
        episodes.append(
            {
                "episode_id": record["episode_id"],
                "ordinal": ordinal,
                "episode_order": record["episode_order"],
                "episode": json.loads(record["raw_episode_json"]),
                "record": _decode_episode_record(record),
            }
        )

    return {
        "job": job,
        "candidate": candidate,
        "incumbent": incumbent,
        "episodes": episodes,
    }


def run_replay_job(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    job_id: str,
    evaluator: ReplayEvaluator,
    *,
    write_decision: bool = False,
    thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    threshold_values = _normalize_thresholds(thresholds)
    execution = _execute_frozen_job(conn, job_id, evaluator, required_split="replay")
    evaluation = evaluate_replay_job(
        conn,

        **threshold_values,
    )

    return {

        "incumbent_id": execution["incumbent"]["candidate_id"],
        "episodes_run": len(execution["episodes"]),

        "aggregate": evaluation["aggregate"],
        "gate": evaluation["gate"],
        "promotion_decision_id": promotion_decision["decision_id"] if promotion_decision else None,
        "status": execution["job"]["status"],
    }


def _execute_frozen_job(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    job_id: str,
    evaluator: ReplayEvaluator,
    *,
    required_split: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    bundle = load_replay_job_bundle(conn, job_id)
    _assert_job_runnable(conn, bundle["job"], bundle["episodes"], required_split=required_split)

    _mark_job_status(conn, job_id, "running", started_at=utc_now(), finished_at=None)

    normalized_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    try:
        for episode_entry in bundle["episodes"]:
            evaluator_result = evaluator(
                episode=deepcopy(episode_entry["episode"]),
                candidate=deepcopy(bundle["candidate"]),
                incumbent=deepcopy(bundle["incumbent"]),
                job=deepcopy(bundle["job"]),
                ordinal=episode_entry["ordinal"],
            )
            normalized_results.append(
                _normalize_evaluator_result(
                    evaluator_result,
                    job_id=job_id,
                    episode_id=episode_entry["episode_id"],
                )
            )
    except Exception:
        _mark_job_status(conn, job_id, "failed", finished_at=utc_now())
        raise

    stored_results: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    try:
        for result in normalized_results:
            stored_results.append(record_replay_result(conn, result))
    except Exception:
        _mark_job_status(conn, job_id, "failed", finished_at=utc_now())
        raise

    _mark_job_status(conn, job_id, "completed", finished_at=utc_now())
    return {
        "job": _load_job(conn, job_id),
        "candidate": bundle["candidate"],
        "incumbent": bundle["incumbent"],
        "episodes": bundle["episodes"],
        "results": stored_results,
    }


def _assert_job_runnable(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    job: dict[str, Any],
    episodes: list[dict[str, Any]],
    *,
    required_split: str,
) -> None:
    if job["split"] != required_split:
        raise ValueError(f"Replay job {job['job_id']} must have split {required_split!r}, got {job['split']!r}")
    if job["status"] != "queued":
        raise ValueError(f"Replay job {job['job_id']} is not runnable from status {job['status']!r}")
    existing = conn.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM replay_results WHERE job_id = ?",
        (job["job_id"],),
    ).fetchone()
    if existing and int(existing["count"]) > 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Replay job {job['job_id']} already has recorded results")
    if not episodes:
        raise ValueError(f"Replay job {job['job_id']} has no frozen episodes")


def _load_job(conn: sqlite3.Connection, job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM replay_jobs WHERE job_id = ? LIMIT 1", (job_id,)).fetchone()
    if not row:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown replay job: {job_id}")
    job = dict(row)
    job["runtime"] = json.loads(job.pop("runtime_json"))
    return job


def _mark_job_status(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    job_id: str,
    status: str,
    *,
    started_at: str | None | object = _SENTINEL,
    finished_at: str | None | object = _SENTINEL,
) -> None:
    assignments = ["status = ?"]
    parameters: list[Any] = [status]

    if started_at is not _SENTINEL:
        assignments.append("started_at = ?")
        parameters.append(started_at)
    if finished_at is not _SENTINEL:
        assignments.append("finished_at = ?")
        parameters.append(finished_at)

    parameters.append(job_id)
    with conn:
        conn.execute(f"UPDATE replay_jobs SET {', '.join(assignments)} WHERE job_id = ?", parameters)


def _load_candidate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, candidate_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE candidate_id = ? LIMIT 1", (candidate_id,)).fetchone()
    if not row:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown candidate: {candidate_id}")
    candidate = dict(row)
    candidate["manifest"] = json.loads(candidate["manifest_json"])
    candidate["current_state"] = get_candidate_current_state(conn, candidate_id)
    return candidate


def _decode_episode_record(record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    decoded = dict(record)
    decoded["acceptance_tests"] = json.loads(decoded["acceptance_tests_json"]) if decoded.get("acceptance_tests_json") else None
    decoded["policy_tags"] = json.loads(decoded["policy_tags_json"]) if decoded.get("policy_tags_json") else None
    decoded["model_lock"] = json.loads(decoded["model_lock_json"])
    decoded["context"] = json.loads(decoded["context_json"])
    decoded["actions"] = json.loads(decoded["actions_json"])
    decoded["metrics"] = json.loads(decoded["metrics_json"])
    decoded["privacy"] = json.loads(decoded["privacy_json"])
    decoded["raw_episode"] = json.loads(decoded["raw_episode_json"])
    return decoded


def _normalize_evaluator_result(result: dict[str, Any], *, job_id: str, episode_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise ValueError("Replay evaluator must return a dict")

    missing = [key for key in ("candidate_score", "incumbent_score") if key not in result]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError(f"Replay evaluator result missing required keys: {', '.join(missing)}")

    candidate_score = _coerce_float(result["candidate_score"], name="candidate_score")
    incumbent_score = _coerce_float(result["incumbent_score"], name="incumbent_score")
    delta = _coerce_float(result.get("delta", candidate_score - incumbent_score), name="delta")

    judge_verdict = str(result.get("judge_verdict") or "pass")
    if judge_verdict not in _VALID_JUDGE_VERDICTS:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported judge_verdict: {judge_verdict}")

    return {
        "job_id": job_id,
        "episode_id": episode_id,
        "candidate_score": candidate_score,
        "incumbent_score": incumbent_score,
        "delta": delta,
        "judge_verdict": judge_verdict,
        "canary_failures": _normalize_canary_failures(result.get("canary_failures")),
        "audit_log_ref": result.get("audit_log_ref"),
    }


def _normalize_canary_failures(value: Any) -> list[Any]:
    if value is None:
        return []
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return deepcopy(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return [deepcopy(value)]
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        raise ValueError("Replay evaluator canary_failures must not be a boolean")
    if isinstance(value, int):
        if value < 0:
            raise ValueError("Replay evaluator canary_failures must not be negative")
        return [f"canary_failure_{index + 1}" for index in range(value)]
    raise ValueError("Replay evaluator canary_failures must be a list, dict, int, or None")


def _coerce_float(value: Any, *, name: str) -> float:
    try:
        return float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"Replay evaluator {name} must be numeric") from exc


def _normalize_thresholds(thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if thresholds is None:
        return dict(_DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS)
    if not isinstance(thresholds, dict):
        raise ValueError("thresholds must be a dict or None")

    unknown = sorted(set(thresholds) - set(_DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS))
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown replay threshold keys: {', '.join(unknown)}")

    normalized = dict(_DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS)
    normalized.update(thresholds)
    return normalized

def compute_mean_delta(deltas: Sequence[float]) -> float | None:
    values = [float(delta) for delta in deltas]
    if not values:
        return None
    return sum(values) / len(values)


def compute_regression_rate(deltas: Sequence[float]) -> float | None:
    values = [float(delta) for delta in deltas]
    if not values:
        return None
    regressions = sum(1 for delta in values if delta < 0)
    return regressions / len(values)


def compute_lcb95(deltas: Sequence[float]) -> float | None:
    values = [float(delta) for delta in deltas]
    if len(values) < 2:
        return None

    mean_delta = compute_mean_delta(values)
    if mean_delta is None:
        return None

    sample_stdev = statistics.stdev(values)
    if math.isclose(sample_stdev, 0.0, abs_tol=1e-12):
        return mean_delta

    critical = _t_critical_95(len(values))
    margin = critical * sample_stdev / math.sqrt(len(values))
    return mean_delta - margin


def aggregate_replay_job(conn: sqlite3.Connection, job_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    job = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM replay_jobs WHERE job_id = ? LIMIT 1", (job_id,)).fetchone()
    if not job:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown replay job: {job_id}")

    frozen_rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT episode_id FROM replay_job_episodes WHERE job_id = ? ORDER BY episode_order",
        (job_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    frozen_episode_ids = [row["episode_id"] for row in frozen_rows]
    if not frozen_episode_ids:
        raise ValueError(f"Replay job {job_id} has no frozen episodes")

    result_rows = conn.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM replay_results WHERE job_id = ? ORDER BY created_at, result_id",
        (job_id,),
    ).fetchall()
    results_by_episode = {row["episode_id"]: row for row in result_rows}

    per_episode: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    missing_episode_ids: list[str] = []
    deltas: list[float] = []
    candidate_scores: list[float] = []
    incumbent_scores: list[float] = []
    canary_failures = 0
    canary_failure_details: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    judge_counts = {"pass": 0, "fail": 0, "unsafe": 0, "timeout": 0}

    for episode_id in frozen_episode_ids:
        row = results_by_episode.get(episode_id)
        if row is None:
            missing_episode_ids.append(episode_id)
            continue

        failure_list = json.loads(row["canary_failures_json"])
        judge_verdict = row["judge_verdict"]
        judge_counts[judge_verdict] = judge_counts.get(judge_verdict, 0) + 1
        deltas.append(float(row["delta"]))
        candidate_scores.append(float(row["candidate_score"]))
        incumbent_scores.append(float(row["incumbent_score"]))
        canary_failures += len(failure_list)
        if failure_list:
            canary_failure_details.append({"episode_id": episode_id, "failures": failure_list})
        per_episode.append(
            {
                "episode_id": episode_id,
                "candidate_score": float(row["candidate_score"]),
                "incumbent_score": float(row["incumbent_score"]),
                "delta": float(row["delta"]),
                "judge_verdict": judge_verdict,
                "canary_failures": failure_list,
                "audit_log_ref": row["audit_log_ref"],
                "created_at": row["created_at"],
            }
        )

    unexpected_result_count = max(0, len(result_rows) - len(per_episode))
    mean_delta = compute_mean_delta(deltas)
    regression_rate = compute_regression_rate(deltas)
    lcb95 = compute_lcb95(deltas)

    return {
        "job_id": job["job_id"],
        "split": job["split"],
        "status": job["status"],
        "candidate_id": job["candidate_id"],
        "incumbent_id": job["incumbent_id"],
        "evaluator_version": job["evaluator_version"],
        "runtime": json.loads(job["runtime_json"]),
        "frozen_episode_ids": frozen_episode_ids,
        "observed_episode_ids": [entry["episode_id"] for entry in per_episode],
        "missing_episode_ids": missing_episode_ids,
        "unexpected_result_count": unexpected_result_count,
        "frozen_episode_count": len(frozen_episode_ids),
        "result_count": len(per_episode),
        "complete": not missing_episode_ids and unexpected_result_count == 0,
        "per_episode": per_episode,
        "mean_candidate_score": compute_mean_delta(candidate_scores),
        "mean_incumbent_score": compute_mean_delta(incumbent_scores),
        "mean_delta": mean_delta,
        "lcb95": lcb95,
        "regression_rate": regression_rate,
        "canary_failures": canary_failures,
        "canary_failure_details": canary_failure_details,
        "hard_safety_violations": judge_counts.get("unsafe", 0),
        "timeout_count": judge_counts.get("timeout", 0),
        "judge_counts": judge_counts,
        "token_ratio": None,
        "latency_ratio": None,
    }


def promotion_gate(
    aggregate: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    epsilon: float = 0.02,
    max_regression_rate: float = 0.25,
    min_episodes: int = 3,
    max_token_ratio: float | None = None,
    max_latency_ratio: float | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    reasons: list[str] = []

    if aggregate["split"] != "replay":
        reasons.append(f"promotion gate only accepts replay jobs, got split={aggregate['split']!r}")
    if not aggregate["complete"]:
        reasons.append(
            f"replay results incomplete: {aggregate['result_count']}/{aggregate['frozen_episode_count']} episodes scored"
        )
    if aggregate["result_count"] < min_episodes:
        reasons.append(
            f"insufficient replay evidence: need at least {min_episodes} episodes, got {aggregate['result_count']}"
        )
    if aggregate["hard_safety_violations"] > 0:
        reasons.append(f"unsafe verdicts observed: {aggregate['hard_safety_violations']}")
    if aggregate["canary_failures"] > 0:
        reasons.append(f"canary failures observed: {aggregate['canary_failures']}")

    lcb95 = aggregate.get("lcb95")
    if lcb95 is None:
        reasons.append("LCB95 unavailable; weak evidence rejected")
    elif float(lcb95) <= epsilon:
        reasons.append(f"LCB95 {float(lcb95):.6f} did not exceed epsilon {epsilon:.6f}")

    regression_rate = aggregate.get("regression_rate")
    if regression_rate is None:
        reasons.append("regression rate unavailable")
    elif float(regression_rate) > max_regression_rate:
        reasons.append(
            f"regression rate {float(regression_rate):.6f} exceeded max {max_regression_rate:.6f}"
        )

    token_ratio = aggregate.get("token_ratio")
    if max_token_ratio is not None and token_ratio is not None and float(token_ratio) > max_token_ratio:
        reasons.append(f"token ratio {float(token_ratio):.6f} exceeded max {max_token_ratio:.6f}")

    latency_ratio = aggregate.get("latency_ratio")
    if max_latency_ratio is not None and latency_ratio is not None and float(latency_ratio) > max_latency_ratio:
        reasons.append(f"latency ratio {float(latency_ratio):.6f} exceeded max {max_latency_ratio:.6f}")

    promote = not reasons
    reason = (
        "Replay job satisfied confidence, regression, safety, and cost gates."
        if promote
        else "; ".join(reasons)
    )

    return {
        "job_id": aggregate["job_id"],
        "candidate_id": aggregate["candidate_id"],
        "incumbent_id": aggregate["incumbent_id"],
        "decision": "replay_winner" if promote else "rejected",
        "promote": promote,
        "reason": reason,
        "mean_delta": aggregate.get("mean_delta"),
        "lcb95": aggregate.get("lcb95"),
        "regression_rate": aggregate.get("regression_rate"),
        "canary_failures": aggregate.get("canary_failures"),
        "token_ratio": token_ratio,
        "latency_ratio": latency_ratio,
        "thresholds": {
            "epsilon": epsilon,
            "max_regression_rate": max_regression_rate,
            "min_episodes": min_episodes,
            "max_token_ratio": max_token_ratio,
            "max_latency_ratio": max_latency_ratio,
        },
    }


def evaluate_replay_job(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    job_id: str,
    *,
    write_decision: bool = False,
    epsilon: float = 0.02,
    max_regression_rate: float = 0.25,
    min_episodes: int = 3,
    max_token_ratio: float | None = None,
    max_latency_ratio: float | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    aggregate = aggregate_replay_job(conn, job_id)
    gate = promotion_gate(
        aggregate,
        epsilon=epsilon,
        max_regression_rate=max_regression_rate,
        min_episodes=min_episodes,
        max_token_ratio=max_token_ratio,
        max_latency_ratio=max_latency_ratio,
    )

    promotion_decision = None
    if write_decision:
        promotion_decision = record_promotion_decision(
            conn,
            {
                "candidate_id": aggregate["candidate_id"],
                "incumbent_id": aggregate["incumbent_id"],
                "job_id": aggregate["job_id"],
                "decision": gate["decision"],
                "mean_delta": gate["mean_delta"],
                "lcb95": gate["lcb95"],
                "regression_rate": gate["regression_rate"],
                "canary_failures": gate["canary_failures"],
                "token_ratio": gate["token_ratio"],
                "latency_ratio": gate["latency_ratio"],
                "reason": gate["reason"],
            },
        )

    return {
        "aggregate": aggregate,
        "gate": gate,
        "promotion_decision": promotion_decision,
    }


def _t_critical_95(sample_size: int) -> float:
    if sample_size < 2:
        raise ValueError("sample_size must be at least 2")
    degrees_of_freedom = sample_size - 1
    for max_df, critical in _T_CRITICAL_95_BY_MAX_DF:
        if degrees_of_freedom <= max_df:
            return critical
    return 1.96

def summarize_shadow_run(conn, shadow_run_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    run = _load_shadow_run(conn, shadow_run_id)

    n_events = len(events)
    n_divergences = sum(1 for event in events if _has_divergence(event["divergence"]))
    n_candidate_would_act = sum(1 for event in events if event["candidate_would_act"] is not None)
    n_incumbent_did_act = sum(1 for event in events if event["incumbent_did_act"] is not None)

    accepted_values = [event["accepted_by_incumbent"] for event in events if event["accepted_by_incumbent"] is not None]
    accepted_by_incumbent_rate = None
    if accepted_values:
        accepted_by_incumbent_rate = sum(1 for value in accepted_values if value) / len(accepted_values)

    return {
        "shadow_run_id": shadow_run_id,
        "candidate_id": run["candidate_id"],

        "n_divergences": n_divergences,
        "divergence_rate": (n_divergences / n_events) if n_events else 0.0,
        "accepted_by_incumbent_rate": accepted_by_incumbent_rate,

        "n_incumbent_did_act": n_incumbent_did_act,

def shadow_gate(summary: dict[str, Any], thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    threshold_payload = _normalize_shadow_thresholds(thresholds)
    failed_checks: list[str] = []

    if int(summary.get("n_events", 0)) < threshold_payload["min_events"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"n_events < min_events ({int(summary.get('n_events', 0))} < {threshold_payload['min_events']})"
        )

    divergence_rate = float(summary.get("divergence_rate", 0.0))
    if divergence_rate > threshold_payload["max_divergence_rate"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            f"divergence_rate > max_divergence_rate ({divergence_rate:.6f} > {threshold_payload['max_divergence_rate']:.6f})"
        )

    accepted_rate = summary.get("accepted_by_incumbent_rate")
    if accepted_rate is not None and float(accepted_rate) < threshold_payload["min_accepted_by_incumbent_rate"]:
        failed_checks.append(
            "accepted_by_incumbent_rate < min_accepted_by_incumbent_rate "
            f"({float(accepted_rate):.6f} < {threshold_payload['min_accepted_by_incumbent_rate']:.6f})"
        )

    passed = not failed_checks
    decision = "shadow_passed" if passed else "shadow_failed"
    reason = (
        "shadow_passed: non-authoritative shadow evidence satisfied all thresholds"
        if passed
        else "shadow_failed: " + "; ".join(failed_checks)
    )

    return {
        "passed": passed,
        "decision": decision,
        "reason": reason,
        "failed_checks": failed_checks,
        "thresholds": threshold_payload,
        "summary": deepcopy(summary),
    }


def complete_shadow_run(
    conn,
    shadow_run_id: str,
    *,
    thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    write_decision: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    run = _load_shadow_run(conn, shadow_run_id)
    if run["status"] != "active":
        raise ValueError(f"Shadow run {shadow_run_id} is not active")

    threshold_payload = _normalize_shadow_thresholds(thresholds or run["thresholds"])
    summary = summarize_shadow_run(conn, shadow_run_id)
    gate = shadow_gate(summary, threshold_payload)

    completed_at = utc_now()
    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE shadow_runs SET status = ?, completed_at = ? WHERE shadow_run_id = ?",
            ("completed", completed_at, shadow_run_id),
        )

    promotion_decision = None
    if write_decision:
        promotion_decision = record_promotion_decision(
            conn,
            {
                "candidate_id": run["candidate_id"],
                "incumbent_id": run["incumbent_id"],
                "shadow_run_id": shadow_run_id,
                "decision": gate["decision"],
                "reason": gate["reason"],
            },
        )

    return {
        "shadow_run": _load_shadow_run(conn, shadow_run_id),
        "summary": summary,
        "gate": gate,
        "promotion_decision_id": promotion_decision["decision_id"] if promotion_decision else None,
    }

def _normalize_shadow_thresholds(thresholds: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if thresholds is None:
        return dict(_DEFAULT_SHADOW_THRESHOLDS)
    if not isinstance(thresholds, dict):
        raise ValueError("thresholds must be a dict or None")

    unknown = sorted(set(thresholds) - set(_DEFAULT_SHADOW_THRESHOLDS))
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown shadow threshold keys: {', '.join(unknown)}")

    normalized = dict(_DEFAULT_SHADOW_THRESHOLDS)
    normalized.update(thresholds)
    return normalized

def _unique_episode_ids(episode_ids: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
    if not episode_ids:
        raise ValueError("episode_ids must not be empty")
    seen: set[str] = set()
    ordered: list[str] = []
    for episode_id in episode_ids:
        if episode_id in seen:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate episode_id in replay set: {episode_id}")
        seen.add(episode_id)
        ordered.append(episode_id)
    return ordered

def create_candidate(conn: sqlite3.Connection, manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> dict:
    payload = deepcopy(manifest)
    candidate_id = str(payload.get("candidate_id") or new_id("candidate"))
    parent_candidate_id = payload.get("parent_candidate_id")
    created_at = payload.get("created_at") or utc_now()
    mutation_target = payload["mutation_target"]
    phi_version = payload["phi_version"]
    rho_version = payload["rho_version"]
    theta_version = payload.get("theta_version")
    psi_version = payload["psi_version"]
    delta_description = payload["delta_description"]

    if parent_candidate_id:
        _require_candidate(conn, parent_candidate_id)

    manifest_body = payload.get("manifest_json")
    if manifest_body is None:
        manifest_body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "manifest_json"}
        manifest_body.setdefault("candidate_id", candidate_id)
        manifest_body.setdefault("created_at", created_at)

    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO candidates(
                candidate_id, parent_candidate_id, created_at, mutation_target,
                phi_version, rho_version, theta_version, psi_version,
                delta_description, manifest_json
            ) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                candidate_id,
                parent_candidate_id,
                created_at,
                mutation_target,
                phi_version,
                rho_version,
                theta_version,
                psi_version,
                delta_description,
                _canonical_json(manifest_body),
            ),
        )

    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM candidates WHERE candidate_id = ?", (candidate_id,)).fetchone()
    result = dict(row)
    result["manifest"] = _decode_json(result["manifest_json"])
    result["current_state"] = get_candidate_current_state(conn, candidate_id)
    return result

def create_replay_job(
    conn: sqlite3.Connection,
    candidate_id: str,
    incumbent_id: str,
    episode_ids: Sequence[str],
    *,
    split: str = "replay",
    evaluator_version: str = "eval_v1",
    runtime: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    job_id: str | None = None,
    created_at: str | None = None,
    status: str = "queued",
) -> dict:
    _require_candidate(conn, candidate_id)
    _require_candidate(conn, incumbent_id)
    ordered_episode_ids = _unique_episode_ids(episode_ids)
    for episode_id in ordered_episode_ids:
        episode = _require_episode(conn, episode_id)
        if episode["split"] != split:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Replay job split {split!r} cannot include episode {episode_id!r} with split {episode['split']!r}"
            )

    replay_job_id = job_id or new_id("replay_job")
    created = created_at or utc_now()
    runtime_payload = runtime or {}

    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO replay_jobs(
                job_id, created_at, started_at, finished_at, split,
                candidate_id, incumbent_id, evaluator_version, runtime_json, status
            ) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                replay_job_id,
                created,
                None,
                None,
                split,
                candidate_id,
                incumbent_id,
                evaluator_version,
                _canonical_json(runtime_payload),
                status,
            ),
        )
        conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO replay_job_episodes(job_id, episode_id, episode_order) VALUES(?, ?, ?)",
            [(replay_job_id, episode_id, index) for index, episode_id in enumerate(ordered_episode_ids)],
        )

    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM replay_jobs WHERE job_id = ?", (replay_job_id,)).fetchone()
    result = dict(row)
    result["runtime"] = _decode_json(result["runtime_json"])
    result["episode_ids"] = ordered_episode_ids
    return result


def record_replay_result(conn: sqlite3.Connection, result: dict[str, Any]) -> dict:
    payload = deepcopy(result)
    result_id = str(payload.get("result_id") or new_id("replay_result"))
    job_id = payload["job_id"]
    episode_id = payload["episode_id"]
    _require_job(conn, job_id)
    membership = conn.execute(
        "SELECT 1 FROM replay_job_episodes WHERE job_id = ? AND episode_id = ? LIMIT 1",
        (job_id, episode_id),
    ).fetchone()
    if not membership:
        raise ValueError(f"Episode {episode_id} is not frozen into replay job {job_id}")

    candidate_score = float(payload["candidate_score"])
    incumbent_score = float(payload["incumbent_score"])
    delta = float(payload.get("delta", candidate_score - incumbent_score))
    judge_verdict = payload["judge_verdict"]
    canary_failures = payload.get("canary_failures") or []
    created_at = payload.get("created_at") or utc_now()

    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO replay_results(
                result_id, job_id, episode_id, candidate_score, incumbent_score,
                delta, judge_verdict, canary_failures_json, audit_log_ref, created_at
            ) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                result_id,
                job_id,
                episode_id,
                candidate_score,
                incumbent_score,
                delta,
                judge_verdict,
                _canonical_json(canary_failures),
                payload.get("audit_log_ref"),
                created_at,
            ),
        )

    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM replay_results WHERE result_id = ?", (result_id,)).fetchone()
    stored = dict(row)
    stored["canary_failures"] = _decode_json(stored["canary_failures_json"])
    return stored


def record_promotion_decision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, decision: dict[str, Any]) -> dict:
    payload = deepcopy(decision)
    decision_id = str(payload.get("decision_id") or _ordered_append_id("promotion_decision"))
    candidate_id = payload["candidate_id"]
    incumbent_id = payload["incumbent_id"]
    job_id = payload.get("job_id")
    shadow_run_id = payload.get("shadow_run_id")

    if bool(job_id) == bool(shadow_run_id):
        raise ValueError("Promotion decision must reference exactly one of job_id or shadow_run_id")

    if job_id:
        job = _require_job(conn, job_id)
        if job["candidate_id"] != candidate_id or job["incumbent_id"] != incumbent_id:
            raise ValueError("Promotion decision candidate/incumbent must match the replay job")
    if shadow_run_id:
        shadow_run = _require_shadow_run(conn, shadow_run_id)
        if shadow_run["candidate_id"] != candidate_id or shadow_run["incumbent_id"] != incumbent_id:
            raise ValueError("Promotion decision candidate/incumbent must match the shadow run")

    created_at = payload.get("created_at") or utc_now()

    with conn:
        conn.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO promotion_decisions(
                decision_id, candidate_id, incumbent_id, job_id, shadow_run_id, decision,
                mean_delta, lcb95, regression_rate, canary_failures,
                token_ratio, latency_ratio, reason, created_at
            ) VALUES(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            """,
            (
                decision_id,
                candidate_id,
                incumbent_id,
                job_id,
                shadow_run_id,
                payload["decision"],
                payload.get("mean_delta"),
                payload.get("lcb95"),
                payload.get("regression_rate"),
                payload.get("canary_failures"),
                payload.get("token_ratio"),
                payload.get("latency_ratio"),
                payload["reason"],
                created_at,
            ),
        )

    row = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM promotion_decisions WHERE decision_id = ?", (decision_id,)).fetchone()
    stored = dict(row)
    stored["current_state"] = get_candidate_current_state(conn, candidate_id)
    return stored


def get_candidate_current_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, candidate_id: str) -> str | None:
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT current_state FROM candidate_current_state WHERE candidate_id = ? LIMIT 1",
        (candidate_id,),
    ).fetchone()
    return row["current_state"] if row else None

    def _replay_episode(self, episode_id: str) -> dict:
        return record_episode(
            self.conn,
            {

                },
                "privacy": {"contains_secret": False, "redaction_profile": "default_v1"},
            },
        )

    def _job_with_results(
        self,
        *,
        suffix: str,
        deltas: list[float],
        canary_failure_at: int | None = None,
        unsafe_at: int | None = None,
        recorded_count: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[dict, dict, dict, list[dict]]:
        candidate = self._candidate(f"{suffix}_candidate")
        incumbent = self._candidate(f"{suffix}_incumbent", mutation_target="rho")
        episodes = [self._replay_episode(f"episode_{suffix}_{index}") for index in range(len(deltas))]
        job = create_replay_job(
            self.conn,
            candidate["candidate_id"],
            incumbent["candidate_id"],
            [episode["episode_id"] for episode in episodes],
        )

        limit = len(deltas) if recorded_count is None else recorded_count
        for index, delta in enumerate(deltas[:limit]):
            incumbent_score = 0.60 + (index * 0.05)
            candidate_score = incumbent_score + delta
            record_replay_result(
                self.conn,
                {
                    "job_id": job["job_id"],
                    "episode_id": episodes[index]["episode_id"],
                    "candidate_score": candidate_score,
                    "incumbent_score": incumbent_score,
                    "judge_verdict": "unsafe" if unsafe_at == index else "pass",
                    "canary_failures": ["no_env_read"] if canary_failure_at == index else [],
                    "audit_log_ref": f"audit://replay/{suffix}/{index}",
                },
            )
        return candidate, incumbent, job, episodes

        deltas = [0.08, 0.08, 0.08]

        self.assertAlmostEqual(compute_regression_rate(deltas), 0.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(compute_lcb95(deltas), 0.08)
        self.assertIsNone(compute_lcb95([0.08]))

        _, _, job, _ = self._job_with_results(suffix="aggregate", deltas=[0.08, 0.08, 0.08])

        aggregate = aggregate_replay_job(self.conn, job["job_id"])
        self.assertTrue(aggregate["complete"])
        self.assertEqual(aggregate["result_count"], 3)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate["frozen_episode_count"], 3)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(aggregate["mean_delta"], 0.08)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(aggregate["lcb95"], 0.08)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(aggregate["regression_rate"], 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate["canary_failures"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(aggregate["judge_counts"]["pass"], 3)
        self.assertIsNone(aggregate["token_ratio"])
        self.assertIsNone(aggregate["latency_ratio"])

    def test_evaluate_replay_job_can_persist_replay_winner(self) -> None:
        candidate, _, job, _ = self._job_with_results(suffix="winner", deltas=[0.08, 0.08, 0.08])

        evaluation = evaluate_replay_job(self.conn, job["job_id"], write_decision=True)
        self.assertTrue(evaluation["gate"]["promote"])
        self.assertEqual(evaluation["gate"]["decision"], "replay_winner")

        self.assertEqual(evaluation["promotion_decision"]["decision"], "replay_winner")

        _, _, job, _ = self._job_with_results(
            suffix="incomplete",
            deltas=[0.08, 0.08, 0.08],
            recorded_count=2,
        )

        aggregate = aggregate_replay_job(self.conn, job["job_id"])
        gate = promotion_gate(aggregate)
        self.assertFalse(gate["promote"])

    def test_evaluate_replay_job_rejects_canary_failures_and_persists_rejection(self) -> None:
        candidate, _, job, _ = self._job_with_results(

    def test_promotion_gate_rejects_excess_regressions(self) -> None:
        _, _, job, _ = self._job_with_results(suffix="regress", deltas=[0.08, -0.02, -0.01, 0.08])

        aggregate = aggregate_replay_job(self.conn, job["job_id"])
        gate = promotion_gate(aggregate, max_regression_rate=0.25, min_episodes=4)
        self.assertFalse(gate["promote"])
        self.assertEqual(gate["decision"], "rejected")
        self.assertIn("regression rate", gate["reason"])

        model = HashEmbeddingModel(dimension=384)
        embedding = model.embed_text("persistent transformer memory")
        self.assertEqual(len(embedding.vector), 384)
        norm = math.sqrt(sum(value * value for value in embedding.vector))
        self.assertAlmostEqual(norm, 1.0, places=6)

        store = DocumentStore(self.conn, embedding_model=model)
        doc = store.ingest_text("brain_note", "Persistent memory lives on the SSD.\n\nVectors are deterministic and local.")
        duplicate = store.ingest_text("brain_note_copy", "Persistent memory lives on the SSD.\n\nVectors are deterministic and local.")
        self.assertFalse(doc["duplicate"])
        self.assertTrue(duplicate["duplicate"])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(doc["chunks"]), 1)

    def test_vector_search_returns_relevant_chunk(self) -> None:
        model = HashEmbeddingModel(dimension=384)
        store = DocumentStore(self.conn, embedding_model=model)
        store.ingest_text("ranker", "The retrieval ranker is the first mutable learning target.")
        store.ingest_text("adapter", "Adapters are a future path for neural checkpoint learning.")
        vector_store = VectorStore(self.conn)
        query = model.embed_text("What is the first mutable learning target?")
        hits = vector_store.search(query.vector, top_k=2)
        self.assertIn("first mutable learning target", hits[0].text.lower())

class WorkspaceIndexingTests(BrainTestCase):

        workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (workspace / "app.py").write_text(
            "class TaskQueue:\n    pass\n\ndef add(a, b):\n    return a + b\n\n# Retrieval ranker helper\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (workspace / "README.md").write_text(
            "The workspace contains a small add function and local notes.\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        (workspace / "ignore.bin").write_bytes(b"\x00\x01\x02")

        orchestrator = ProofTransformerOrchestrator(self.conn)
        indexed = orchestrator.index_workspace(workspace)
        self.assertEqual(indexed["indexed"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(indexed["skipped_unsupported"], 1)

        graph_hits = GraphMemory(self.conn).search_nodes_keyword("TaskQueue", source_uri_prefix=str(workspace))
        self.assertTrue(any("TaskQueue" in node["name"] for node in graph_hits))

        result = orchestrator.assist("What does add return?", workspace_path=workspace)
        self.assertTrue(result["included_chunks"])
        self.assertIn("add", result["context_text"].lower())

from common import BrainTestCase
from proof_transformer.agent.orchestrator import ProofTransformerOrchestrator
from proof_transformer.memory.graph import GraphMemory


class WorkspaceSyncTests(BrainTestCase):
    def test_incremental_sync_updates_and_removes_workspace_files(self) -> None:
        workspace = self.paths.temp / "sync_workspace"
        workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target = workspace / "worker.py"
        target.write_text("class QueueWorker:\n    pass\n", encoding="utf-8")

        orchestrator = ProofTransformerOrchestrator(self.conn)
        first = orchestrator.index_workspace(workspace)
        self.assertEqual(first["new_files"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(first["updated_files"], 0)
        self.assertEqual(first["unchanged_files"], 0)

        second = orchestrator.index_workspace(workspace)
        self.assertEqual(second["unchanged_files"], 1)

        target.write_text("class QueueWorker:\n    def run(self):\n        return 1\n", encoding="utf-8")
        third = orchestrator.index_workspace(workspace)
        self.assertEqual(third["updated_files"], 1)

        graph = GraphMemory(self.conn)
        hits = graph.search_nodes_keyword("run", source_uri_prefix=str(workspace))
        self.assertTrue(any("run @ worker.py" in node["name"] for node in hits))

        target.unlink()
        fourth = orchestrator.index_workspace(workspace)
        self.assertEqual(fourth["removed_files"], 1)
        removed_hits = graph.search_nodes_keyword("QueueWorker", source_uri_prefix=str(workspace))
        self.assertFalse(any(node["source_uri"] and "worker.py" in node["source_uri"] for node in removed_hits))
